items.definition:
working incorrectly or imperfectly
The washing machine is faulty and needs to be repaired.

productive, able to produce
The fertile soil produced a rich harvest.

showing compassion
They advocated for more humane treatment of animals.

conforming to the law
It is a lawful requirement to wear a seatbelt.

extremely unpleasant; morally bad
He made some vile comments about her.

able to adjust to new conditions
Humans are highly adaptive creatures.

causing addiction
Coffee can be quite addictive.

based on or concerned with fact
Please provide only factual information.

providing useful or interesting information
The documentary was very informative and well-researched.

never ending or changing
The perpetual motion machine is a theoretical concept.

revolving around a central axis
The rotary engine has a unique design.

(especially of food, money, or some other resource) insufficient for the demand
Water is scarce in the desert.

not recognized or identified
An unidentified flying object was spotted in the sky.

feeling or showing tiredness, especially as a result of excessive exertion or lack of sleep
After the long journey, she felt weary.

astonishing or awe-inspiring in quality, so as to take one's breath away
The view from the mountain was breathtaking.

relating to or characteristic of films or the cinema
The director achieved a truly cinematic experience with his new movie.

a rich deep red color inclining to purple
The sunset painted the sky in shades of crimson and orange.

without any imperfections or defects; perfect
Her performance was absolutely flawless.

relating to a Protestant church governed by elders
She attends a Presbyterian church.

corresponding in size or amount to something else
The punishment should be proportional to the crime.

successful in material terms; flourishing financially
The country enjoyed a prosperous economy.

having a broken, uneven, or jagged surface; strong and able to withstand hardship
The hikers explored the rugged terrain of the mountains.

Using irony to mock or convey contempt
Her sarcastic comments often made people uncomfortable.

Muscular and well-built; an enthusiast or expert
He works out regularly and is very buff.

subject to one or more conditions or requirements
The offer of employment is conditional on a successful background check.

not deterred by danger or pain; brave
It was a courageous decision to speak out against the injustice.

believing that people are motivated by self-interest; distrustful of human sincerity
His cynical attitude made it hard for him to trust anyone.

exactly like something else, especially a copy
Make sure you don't create duplicate files on your computer.

giving good value or service in relation to the amount of money, time, or effort spent
Buying in bulk can be more economical in the long run.

enthusiastic or infatuated to an extravagant or irrational degree
She's gone completely gaga over her new puppy.

relating to or denoting geometry
The artist used bold geometric patterns in her design.

courteous, kind, and pleasant
She was a gracious host, making everyone feel welcome.

Relating to marriage or the relationship between a husband and wife.
They discussed their marital problems with a counselor.

Relating to an orbit.
The satellite is in an orbital path around the Earth.

Not or no longer needed or useful; superfluous.
The old system became redundant after the upgrade.

careless and untidy
His work was sloppy and full of errors.

relating to society
We need to address societal issues like poverty.

not real; imaginary or illusory
The special effects in the movie looked completely unreal.

relating to the abdomen
He felt a sharp abdominal pain.

relating to adolescence
Adolescent behavior can be challenging.

of poor quality; cheap or in bad taste
The movie had some really cheesy special effects.

not in accordance with accepted standards, especially of morals or honesty
It was improper for him to discuss confidential information.

requiring a lot of attention or help
The charity helps needy families in the community.

so precious that its value cannot be determined
The ancient artifact was considered priceless.

capable of reflecting light or sound
The cyclist wore a reflective vest for safety.

affirmative; positive
The answer was an affirmative 'yes'.

ambiguous; unclear
The instructions were ambiguous and difficult to follow.

Baltic (relating to the Baltic Sea); very cold (informal)
It's absolutely baltic outside today.

imperfect or faulty
The company recalled the product due to a defective part.

consisting of or resembling fire; passionate
The sunset painted the sky with fiery colors.

causing overwhelming sadness or grief
The news of the accident was absolutely heartbreaking.

easy to understand or use; based on intuition rather than logic
The new software has a very intuitive interface.

impressive and beautiful
The majestic mountains rose high above the valley.

sharp or intense
Her piercing blue eyes seemed to look right through me.

causing shame
His behavior was truly shameful.

not having official permission
Unauthorized access is strictly forbidden.

not identified by name
An unnamed source provided the information.

having won a victory
The team was victorious in the final match.

relating to the Antarctic or South Pole
The Antarctic ice sheet is melting.

combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize the qualities of each other
The two colors are complementary and look good together.

not logical or reasonable
Her fear of flying was completely irrational.

relating to management or managers
She has excellent managerial skills and leads her team effectively.

operating in several countries
She works for a large multinational corporation with offices worldwide.

relating to a planet or planets
Scientists are studying the planetary orbits in our solar system.
